2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Giants' physicality, Jaxson Dart's poise under pressure prove too much for Cowboys
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: The Giants' victory over the Cowboys was largely due to their ability to control the tempo of the game with their running game and Jaxson Dart's efficient passing. New York's physical front and Dart's poise under pressure allowed them to convert 9 of 10 third downs, while the Cowboys' defense struggled to get off the field. The Giants' running back Cam Skattebo and quarterback Jaxson Dart led the charge, with Skattebo rushing for 81 yards and a touchdown, and Dart completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns.

2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes Returns to Lead Chiefs Against Broncos
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos will test the Kansas City Chiefs' rebuilt secondary with their revamped wide receiver corps, led by Jaylen Waddle.
